author: Doug Sharpe
description:
In 1994, the Crown Prince of Qatar, began working on an Arabic oriented news network based on the internationally successful 24 hour news room model.

Al Jazeera launched in 1996, but wouldn't find success until a year later when a French telecommunications company accidentally broadcast a hardcore adult movie across the Middle East.
title: The Unimaginable Origins Of Al Jazeera #funfact
